harness.init: window.__psPlay = async (id) => { const mu = await import('/pop-studio/js/music.js?v=1'), vo = await import('/pop-studio/js/voice.js?v=1'); const song = mu.SAMPLES.find((s) => s.id === id).make(); M.ensure(); await Promise.all([...new Set(song.tracks.filter((x) => x.type === 'inst').map((x) => x.inst))].map(M.loadInstrument)); for (const tr of song.tracks) if (tr.type === 'vocal') { const sy = await vo.syllables(tr.lyrics || ''); tr.notes.slice().sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t).forEach((n, i) => { const s = sy[i]; n.hold = !!(s && s.hold); n.syl = s && !s.hold ? { text: s.text, c: s.c, v: s.v, coda: s.coda } : { text: 'la', c: 'l', v: ['a'], coda: '' }; }); } M.play(song, 0, (tr, n) => n.syl, { loop: true, loopFrom: 0 }); return true; };
harness.notes: play() returns a Promise: the renderer MUST await it before starting the offline render, because the song is built after async steps (import of music.js/voice.js, soundfont fetch + decodeAudioData, pinyin-pro import for Chinese lyrics). Instruments are fetched from https://gleitz.github.io/midi-js-soundfonts/FluidR3_GM/<gm>-mp3.js (network); on failure loadInstrument falls back to the built-in synth, so it still renders. Chinese lyrics need https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pinyin-pro@3.26.0/dist/index.mjs; without it every syllable is sung as 'a'. Mirrors app.js startPlay()+assignLyrics(). Songs include the formant AI singer (lead vocal synthesized in js/voice.js, not a recording). music.js imports './sound.js?v=1' which is a separate module instance from M (js/sound.js); harmless, music.js only reads the SPB constant, and playback goes through M. If the page base is not the site root, the absolute '/pop-studio/...' import paths assume the GitHub Pages layout. loopSec = 8 bars x 4 beats x 60/bpm (sunny 96, drive 108, cafe 78, dance 124 BPM); player starts 0.08 s after play.
